field_key.rows: [season, mlbam, name, team, arb_year, actual_usd, ours_usd, swartz_usd, ou_mkt_usd, ou_war_usd, war, flags, link]
field_key.link: the name's link token, as the board's h: p:<key> opens /projections/#player=<key>, x:<slug> opens /prospx/#player=<slug>, null links nothing
field_key.ou_mkt: actual minus OUR model: what the arbitration system paid relative to comparable players. Sums to roughly zero by construction.
field_key.ou_war: actual minus WAR (fWAR basis) priced at that season's dollars per win. Does NOT sum to zero, because arbitration systematically pays below the open market.
field_key.never_combine: The two residuals answer different questions and are never averaged or summed. No combined column exists and none may be added.
